ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.8:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the distal regions of both lobes. A dominant black central region bifurcates the fluke. The left lobe white field contains a high-contrast black cross-shaped (X) geometric blob and a distinct circular dark focal spot. The right lobe displays vertical, jagged black mottling at the medial-lateral transition.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence point with a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern characterized by jagged peaks and sharp valleys (5-15 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory with high-frequency micro-scale irregularities fitted to the outer edges of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two localized circular dark pixel clusters: one prominent dark ring in the upper-left white field and one smaller circular spot near the lower central junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct intersecting linear black pixel disruptions forming an 'X' pattern on the left lobe; several vertical parallel linear marks (rake-like) visible within the black pigmentation zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge erosion/serration; prominent large-scale intersecting linear scars on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, high-intensity light-colored nodular protrusions visible along the lower-lateral leading edges at the water interface.
